title: Recombinase Polymerase Amplification Assay for Detection of Mycobacterium Ulcerans DNA
author: Michael Frimpong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vvve666

steps.title: Prepare RPA Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix for each sample using the following components:

steps.title: Mix and Resuspend Pellets
steps.instruction: Homogenize the mastermix and combine it with the reaction pellets.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the mastermix to mix and spin down
Transfer 42.5 µL of the mix to each TwistAmp exo reaction pellet
Mix by pipetting up and down until the entire pellet is resuspended

steps.title: Add Template and Magnesium Acetate
steps.instruction: Add the DNA template and the activation reagent to the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the DNA template to the mix
Add 2.5 µL 280 mM magnesium acetate to each sample and mix well

steps.title: Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in the Axxin T8 Isothermal device.

substeps.instruction: Insert tubes into the Axxin T8 device

steps.title: Intermediate Mixing
steps.instruction: Perform a mid-incubation mix to ensure homogeneity.

substeps.instruction: After 4 minutes, remove samples from the device
Return samples to the T8 device
Continue incubation/detection for a total incubation time of 15 minutes
